macro.regime: Pre-FOMC de-risk: metals give back Monday's bounce, oil keeps sliding; Fed decides 29 Jul
macro.narrative: Re-verified Wed 29 Jul 07:00 SGT (pre-Asia-open) against the Tue 28 Jul US close — the day BEFORE the FOMC decision (Wed 29 Jul 2pm ET ≈ 2am SGT Thu 30 Jul; not yet happened). Two things reversed Monday's read: the metals rebound gave back and risk assets de-risked into the Fed, even as the oil slide extended. Silver fell ~2% to ~$57.5 (from ~$59.4) and gold slipped ~1.25% to ~$4,030 (from ~$4,098) as a firmer dollar and pre-FOMC caution overrode the oil relief — Monday's bounce did not hold. Brent fell a further ~4.8% to ~$84 and WTI ~4% to ~$79 as the US-Iran pause held (Iran now in Strait-of-Hormuz talks with Saudi Arabia and Oman), deflating the war premium further. US equities ground to fresh records on rotation — S&P 500 +0.21% to 7,428.78, Dow +1.03% to 52,747 on falling oil and strong earnings (KO best day since 2009) — but the Nasdaq slipped -0.22% (24,877) as a global chip rout deepened: a report that NVDA is exploring a ~$250B OpenAI financing backstop stoked circular-financing fears, cascading into a KOSPI circuit-breaker (~-10%) and Nikkei -4.4% on Tuesday, with SMIC giving back gains. Crypto de-risked (BTC ~$63.5k -2.5%, ETH ~$1,885 -3.2%, crypto Fear&Greed ~28). The 10Y eased to ~4.62% (from ~4.71%) as the oil drop cut the inflation premium; HY OAS ~277bp still tight. The FOMC hold is the base case (~64-66% hold / ~34-36% hike; September hike odds still ~80%), decision Wed 29 Jul 2pm ET, no SEP, Warsh hawkish/no-guidance. Flows turned decisively DM→EM/China: China drew a record 3rd-largest +$21.3bn weekly inflow and EM +$29.6bn (2nd-largest ever) while US equities bled -$7.2bn (BofA/EPFR, wk to 22 Jul) — a real bid under the HK-tech core. The single biggest swing into the print is whether Warsh delivers a hawkish hold/hike (pressures silver/S-REITs/crypto further) or a data-dependent tone that lets the metals bid rebuild; MSFT/META (Wed) and AAPL/AMZN (Thu) earnings then test the AI-capex trade.
